_comment: Every run of the experiment, in the order they run (PROTOCOL.md). Each changes one thing from b0. 'models' is the chat model per step; 'overrides' are changes to 01's data/settings.json; 'labelled' runs are on the test split and go to the blind worksheet. v4 has no run: it is assembled from b0 and v3 by report.py (PROTOCOL.md, V4).

b0dev.purpose: the baseline on the development emails, only to set v2's output cap; never labelled or reported as a result

b0.purpose: the baseline: 01's pipeline as #18 and #33 ran it (prompts v3, policy none)

v1.purpose: send less: half the retrieval budget

v2.purpose: write less: an output cap at the typical reply length (the rule is in PROTOCOL.md and run.py)

v3.purpose: a smaller model for drafting; extraction stays on the baseline model

v3r.purpose: v3 again, only to compare text with v3 (run-to-run variation of the smaller model); never labelled

cap_rule: the median output tokens of b0dev's draft calls, rounded up to the next multiple of 10
